acquisition method: the 20 most intense peptide ions (Top20 method) of the FTMS scan with a minimal signal intensity of 1,500 and a charge range >+2 were selected and fragmented by CID
cleavage agent: Dry gel pieces were digested using 5 μL of 2.0 μg/μL trypsin in 10 mM HCl
collision energy: fragmented by CID with a collision energy of 35%
enrichment method: Strep-tactin affinity purification, nickel-nitrilotriacetic acid (Ni-NTA) affinity purification

Strep-LpxC or Strep-tag were purified by Strep-tactin affinity purification (IBA Lifescience, manufacturer protocol) and His6-MBP-FtsH or His6-MBP by nickel-nitrilotriacetic acid (Ni-NTA) affinity purification as described previously.
fragmentation method: fragmented by CID with a collision energy of 35%
instrument: Orbitrap Elite hybrid ion trap-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
coupled to an Orbitrap Elite hybrid ion trap-Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: For quantification, a heavy labeled super-SILAC standard was used as established previously.
